audit.whatIsWrong: The entry puts Quinn's blind on her E in six places — 'her E vault blinds your autos', 'her vault-blind', 'Bait her E vault (the blind plus knockback)', 'Vault (E) ... to blind your autos'. The blind is on her Q, Blinding Assault. Vault does not blind at all.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.' Riot's E text: 'Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away.' They are two different buttons on two different cooldowns — Q 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, E 12/11/10/9/8s. Merging them means the player waits out the wrong cooldown before committing.
audit.corrected: Blinding Assault (Q) turns off your autos, 11s at rank 1. Vault (E) interrupts you and repositions her out of range, 12s at rank 1. Bait E for the engage window; trade after Q, not into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vault's interrupt was never mentioned, and Behind Enemy Lines being a channel was absent.
audit.why: missingInteractions: 'Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines (R) is a channel — your Flawless Duet (E) cancels it outright.' Riot's E text also states she 'briefly interrupts' the target on the leap-off, which is what breaks your combo mid-chain.
audit.corrected: Your stun cancels her R flat. Her E interrupts you on the leap-off, so expect the chain to break rather than just the distance to open.

audit.whatIsWrong: Her kiting move speed is attributed to Harrier ('her Harrier move-speed kites the follow-up', 'Kite with Harrier move-speed procs').
audit.why: Harrier is the mark plus bonus first-attack damage. The move speed and attack speed are on W, Heightened Senses, granted after she attacks a Harrier target.
audit.corrected: Named as Heightened Senses off a Harrier proc.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with their whys text. whys[0] ends 'so you just farm' with the row reading Irelia; whys[1] opens 'She still owns it' with the row reading Skill; whys[2] ends "so it's even" with the row reading Quinn; whys[5] ends 'so call it even' with the row reading Quinn.
audit.why: The packet chart (Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Quinn, Irelia, Skill, Quinn) matches the prose on all seven rows, and matches the 48.21% win rate.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings 3/10 Quinn, 5/10 even.

audit.why: Spike shape is right and unusually well-observed for this repo: Quinn owns 1-3, Irelia's single window is Vanguard's Edge at 6 (125s at rank 1), and Quinn reclaims from first item onward. No invented Trinity Force here.
audit.corrected: Left as-is apart from the ability-name fixes inside the spike text.

notes: The whole entry had Quinn's blind on the wrong ability — six mentions of 'her E vault blinds your autos'. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q, 11s at rank 1); Vault (E, 12s) is a dash that interrupts and repositions her. That matters concretely: the player was being told to bait out the blind by baiting E, which does not remove the blind at all. Vault's interrupt on the leap-off and Behind Enemy Lines being a cancellable channel were both missing and are now stated. Chart flipped to the packet chart on four rows, all of which already contradicted their own whys text.
